payload.message: Anyone who was in a frat or a sorority, drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} gives another player a new name. Anyone who doesn't refer to them by this name must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves up two spaces!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} picks another player to drink!
The person who goes next plays asks {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} truth or dare. If {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} doesn't comply, they must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} gets to make a new rule. Anyone who breaks the rule must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} takes a drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must reveal an embarrassing secret or drink!
Everyone take a drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} gets to distribute 3 drinks among any number of players.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} picks a drinking buddy! Anytime {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} drinks, this player must also drink (but not vice versa).
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} gets to pick another player to give a compliment. Afterwards, both involved players take a drink <3.
The youngest player drinks.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves back two spaces!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} takes a shot! (Or equivalently, 4 drinks if they're lame).
All ladies drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} says something they've never done. Anyone who has done that must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must finish their drink!
Waterfall! {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} will start things off. Go in the player order (or whatever order you want, why would I care?).
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} tells a joke. Anyone who laughs must drink. If no one laughs, {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves back 5 spaces.

Rhyme Time!

Players must take turns saying words that rhyme with:
{{RANDOM_WORD}}

First person to fail drinks. Go in the player list order (or whatever order you want, why would I care?).
Everyone must be silent for 3 turns. Anyone who breaks the silence must drink. If you need to talk for your turn, get creative.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves back two spaces!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} picks another player to drink!
All guys drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} is jail next turn. They must stay sober while in jail.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} gets to make a new rule. Anyone who breaks the rule must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} is safe from drinking until the start of their next turn.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must open up any social media with public posts (instagram, facebook, etc.). Comment on the first post you see or drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves back two spaces!
All guys drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves up two spaces!
Everyone besides {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} take a drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must finish their drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must show their last online purchase or take a drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must call a parent or previous legal guardian or drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must make a toast and everyone drinks!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} is jail next turn. They must stay sober while in jail.

Rhyme Time!

Players must take turns saying words that rhyme with:
{{RANDOM_WORD}}

First person to fail drinks. Go in the player list order (or whatever order you want, why would I care?).
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must share the most recent picture on their camera roll or take a drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} says something they've never done. Anyone who has done that must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} is safe from drinking until the start of their next turn.
Everyone take a drink!
Everyone votes on a player to finish their drink. In the event of a tie, all tied players finish their drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must send a selfie of themselves to all other players or drink.
The person who goes next plays asks {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} truth or dare. If {{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} doesn't comply, they must drink.
All ladies drink.
The oldest player drinks.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must finish their drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must reveal an embarrassing secret or drink!
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must state two lies and a truth. Everyone else then must guess the truth. Anyone who is wrong must drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must read their last received text message or drink.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} moves back 5 spaces.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} is safe from drinking until the start of their next turn.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} must chug their drink for 5 seconds.
{{CURRENT_PLAYER_NAME}} has finished! The rest of you can keep playing if you want, what do I care?
